params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch refactors a complex method by extracting repeated code blocks into two helper methods, checkNextSegment and checkPreviousSegment, which reduces the cognitive complexity of the original method. The changes are focused solely on restructuring the code for better readability and maintainability without altering the logic or introducing unrelated modifications. Minor formatting improvements are also present but are acceptable as they do not affect functionality. No unrelated or unnecessary changes are introduced.

Score: 3
